transformations: Extract all-races 2000 fertility rows; retain nonoverlapping five-year groups 15-19 through 40-44; divide per-1000 values by 1000.

Extract the Table 1 all-races 2000 overall fertility row; retain five-year bands 15-19 through 40-44 and divide rates per 1000 by 1000. Omit 10-14 and 45-49; preserve the published 40-44 rate (not the 40+ numerator used by Tables 7 and 8).
Map married to partnered and unmarried to unpartnered only in the simulation-format fertility file.

Extract marriage entry columns for both sexes, preserving age bands, estimates, starting populations and 90% margins of error. Divide entry estimates by 1000 to produce annual transition proportions, without hazard conversion.

Split marriage entries into female and male three-column schedules (age_start, age_end, rate); use transitions_per_1000 / 1000 directly as per-person-year rates under the user-selected approximation of October 16, 2026. Preserve source bands including 70+; no -log(1-p) transformation.

overall_fertility.age_40_44_numerator: Births to women aged 40-44; differs from the 40+ numerator in marital-status Tables 7 and 8.

marriage_rate_approximation.source_denominator: People unmarried at beginning of period, not person-years
marriage_rate_approximation.female_use: Union-search schedule; realized union formation may differ when searches fail
marriage_rate_approximation.male_use: Reference comparison; engine schedules female searches only
